draft_en.body:
Hi Steve,

You opened our mail on "Marvell Industrial Alert System" (and "Managed Optical Bypass Switch") but had no reason to answer — fair enough. No brochure this time, just one question:

For the industrial switches and media converters you sell under the Maxcom label next to your fibre transport range, we can be a second ODM source on a Marvell platform (DIN-rail 8-PoE + 2 SFP managed/unmanaged, gigabit MC) from small lots in your housing, FCC/CE/RoHS — which model do you reorder most?

If it is not relevant now, a one-word reply is enough and I will take you off the catalog mails.

Best regards,
Alan
